::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
MediaTek's India centre contributes to Dimensity mobile SoC and connectivity chip design. India is a growing design hub for the Taiwanese chipmaker.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Dimensity mobile SoCs, Wi-Fi 7 chipsets, smart TV and streaming media SoCs, and AI processing units for mobile.
